definition: to leave a person, place or thing and never return to it
sentence: I had to {abandon} my car in the snow and walk home.
translation: Мне пришлось бросить машину в снегу и идти домой пешком.

definition: to finish something difficult with success
sentence: We {accomplished} more in one week than they did all month.
translation: Мы за неделю сделали больше, чем они за месяц.

definition: to accept or admit that something is true
sentence: At least he {acknowledged} that it was his mistake.
translation: Он хотя бы признал, что это была его ошибка.

definition: to change how you act so you fit a new situation
sentence: It took me a month to {adapt} to the night shifts.
translation: Мне понадобился месяц, чтобы привыкнуть к ночным сменам.

definition: to change something a little so it works better
sentence: Can you {adjust} the chair? It is too low for me.
translation: Можешь подкрутить кресло? Оно для меня слишком низкое.

definition: to respect and like someone for what they do
sentence: I really {admire} how calm she stays under pressure.
translation: Я правда восхищаюсь тем, как спокойно она держится под давлением.

definition: to speak in public in support of an idea or plan
sentence: She has {advocated} for shorter working weeks for years.
translation: Она уже много лет выступает за короткую рабочую неделю.

definition: to give a part of money, time or space for a purpose
sentence: We {allocated} half the budget to the new kitchen.
translation: Половину бюджета мы отвели на новую кухню.

definition: to expect something and get ready for it
sentence: I didn't {anticipate} so many people coming to the party.
translation: Я не ожидал, что на вечеринку придёт столько людей.

definition: to put the parts of something together
sentence: It took us three hours to {assemble} the wardrobe.
translation: Мы собирали шкаф три часа.

definition: to judge how good, big or important something is
sentence: The doctor needs to {assess} the damage before we talk about surgery.
translation: Врачу нужно оценить повреждение, прежде чем говорить об операции.

definition: to tell someone that something is true so they stop worrying
sentence: He {assured} me the package would arrive by Friday.
translation: Он заверил меня, что посылка придёт к пятнице.

definition: to join or fix one thing to another
sentence: Don't forget to {attach} the photos to the email.
translation: Не забудь прикрепить фотографии к письму.

definition: to make something grow or improve quickly
sentence: A good night's sleep really {boosts} my mood.
translation: Хороший сон здорово поднимает мне настроение.

definition: to stop happening or stop doing something
sentence: The noise upstairs finally {ceased} after midnight.
translation: Шум наверху наконец прекратился после полуночи.

definition: to make something easier to understand by explaining it
sentence: Could you {clarify} what you meant by 'soon'?
translation: Можешь уточнить, что ты имел в виду под «скоро»?

definition: to happen at the same time as something else
sentence: My birthday {coincides} with the first day of the holiday.
translation: Мой день рождения совпадает с первым днём отпуска.

definition: to fall down suddenly because of weakness or no support
sentence: The old shelf {collapsed} under the weight of the books.
translation: Старая полка рухнула под тяжестью книг.

definition: to promise to give your time and effort to something
sentence: I can't {commit} to a weekly class right now.
translation: Я сейчас не могу взять на себя еженедельные занятия.

definition: to give money or something good to make up for a loss
sentence: The airline {compensated} us for the lost luggage.
translation: Авиакомпания возместила нам потерянный багаж.

definition: to do what a rule or request tells you to do
sentence: Everyone in the building has to {comply} with the fire rules.
translation: Все в здании обязаны соблюдать правила пожарной безопасности.

definition: to hide something so that nobody can see or know it
sentence: She tried to {conceal} her surprise when she saw the bill.
translation: Она попыталась скрыть удивление, когда увидела счёт.

definition: to admit that something is true after first saying no
sentence: After an hour he {conceded} that I was right about the route.
translation: Через час он признал, что насчёт маршрута я был прав.

definition: to admit that you did something wrong or that you feel something
sentence: I have to {confess} I never finished that book.
translation: Должен признаться, я так и не дочитал ту книгу.

definition: to keep someone or something inside a limited space or area
sentence: The dog is {confined} to the kitchen while the guests are here.
translation: Пока гости здесь, собака заперта на кухне.

definition: to face a difficult person or problem instead of avoiding it
sentence: I finally {confronted} my neighbour about the loud music.
translation: Я наконец поговорил с соседом насчёт громкой музыки.

definition: to ask a person or a book for advice or information
sentence: You should {consult} a lawyer before you sign anything.
translation: Прежде чем что-то подписывать, посоветуйся с юристом.

definition: to think about something seriously for a long time
sentence: I'm {contemplating} moving to the coast next year.
translation: Я подумываю переехать на побережье в следующем году.

definition: to make a feeling or idea known to someone
sentence: It's hard to {convey} how beautiful the view was.
translation: Трудно передать, какой красивый там был вид.

definition: to deal with a difficult situation without breaking down
sentence: How do you {cope} with two kids and a full-time job?
translation: Как ты справляешься с двумя детьми и работой на полный день?

definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
sentence: He {deceived} everyone about where the money came from.
translation: Он всех обманул насчёт того, откуда взялись деньги.

definition: to politely say no to an offer or invitation
sentence: I had to {decline} the job because of the long commute.
translation: Мне пришлось отказаться от работы из-за долгой дороги.

definition: to give all your time and energy to one thing
sentence: She {dedicated} her whole weekend to fixing the bike.
translation: Она посвятила все выходные ремонту велосипеда.

definition: to get something, like pleasure or an idea, from a source
sentence: I {derive} a lot of pleasure from cooking for friends.
translation: Мне очень приятно готовить для друзей.

definition: to notice or find something that is hard to see
sentence: The app {detected} a problem with my phone's battery.
translation: Приложение обнаружило проблему с батареей телефона.

definition: to become worse over time
sentence: His eyesight has {deteriorated} a lot in the last year.
translation: За последний год его зрение сильно ухудшилось.

definition: to give most of your time or attention to one thing
sentence: He {devotes} every Sunday morning to his garden.
translation: Каждое воскресное утро он отдаёт своему саду.

definition: to tell people a secret or private information
sentence: The company refused to {disclose} how many users it had.
translation: Компания отказалась раскрыть, сколько у неё пользователей.

definition: to refuse to consider an idea because it seems unimportant
sentence: Don't {dismiss} the plan before you hear the details.
translation: Не отметай план, пока не услышишь подробности.

definition: to see or understand the difference between two things
sentence: I can't {distinguish} the twins when they wear the same clothes.
translation: Я не могу различить близнецов, когда они одеты одинаково.

definition: to take someone's attention away from what they are doing
sentence: Please don't {distract} me while I'm driving.
translation: Пожалуйста, не отвлекай меня, пока я за рулём.

definition: to be the strongest or most important in a situation
sentence: Their team {dominated} the whole second half of the match.
translation: Их команда полностью владела игрой весь второй тайм.

definition: to move slowly without a clear direction, carried by water or air
sentence: The boat {drifted} away while we were swimming.
translation: Пока мы купались, лодку отнесло в сторону.

definition: to remove something completely
sentence: We {eliminated} sugar from our breakfast this month.
translation: В этом месяце мы полностью убрали сахар из завтрака.

definition: to accept a new idea or change with enthusiasm
sentence: The whole team {embraced} the idea of working from home.
translation: Вся команда с радостью приняла идею работать из дома.

definition: to come out from a place where you could not be seen
sentence: She {emerged} from the shop with four heavy bags.
translation: Она вышла из магазина с четырьмя тяжёлыми пакетами.

definition: to suffer something painful or unpleasant for a long time
sentence: I can't {endure} another winter in this cold flat.
translation: Я не вынесу ещё одну зиму в этой холодной квартире.

definition: to improve the quality or value of something
sentence: A good sauce can really {enhance} a simple meal.
translation: Хороший соус может здорово улучшить простое блюдо.

definition: to make people obey a rule or law
sentence: Nobody {enforces} the parking rules on this street.
translation: На этой улице никто не следит за правилами парковки.

definition: to judge the value or quality of something carefully
sentence: We'll {evaluate} the results after the first month.
translation: Результаты мы оценим после первого месяца.

definition: to make something seem bigger or better than it really is
sentence: He {exaggerates} every story he tells about his trips.
translation: Он преувеличивает каждую историю о своих поездках.

definition: to be more than a certain number or limit
sentence: The repairs {exceeded} the price of the car itself.
translation: Ремонт обошёлся дороже самой машины.

definition: to keep someone or something out of a group or activity
sentence: Why did they {exclude} me from the meeting?
translation: Почему меня не позвали на встречу?

definition: to use someone unfairly for your own benefit
sentence: That company {exploits} students by paying them almost nothing.
translation: Эта компания пользуется студентами, платя им почти ничего.

definition: to make a process easier or faster
sentence: The new app {facilitates} booking a table in seconds.
translation: Новое приложение позволяет забронировать столик за секунды.

definition: to grow well and be healthy or successful
sentence: My plants {flourish} on the balcony in summer.
translation: Летом мои растения на балконе прекрасно растут.

definition: to order someone not to do something
sentence: My parents {forbade} me to ride a motorbike.
translation: Родители запретили мне ездить на мотоцикле.

definition: to know that something will happen before it does
sentence: Nobody could {foresee} the traffic jam on a Sunday.
translation: Никто не мог предвидеть пробку в воскресенье.

definition: to express an idea or plan in clear words
sentence: Give me a minute to {formulate} my answer.
translation: Дай мне минуту, чтобы сформулировать ответ.

definition: to do what you promised or what was expected
sentence: The hotel didn't {fulfil} any of its promises about the pool.
translation: Отель не выполнил ни одного обещания насчёт бассейна.

definition: to understand a difficult idea completely
sentence: It took me a while to {grasp} how the game works.
translation: Мне понадобилось время, чтобы понять, как устроена игра.

definition: to keep saying in a low voice that you are not happy about something
sentence: He {grumbled} about the price the whole way home.
translation: Он всю дорогу домой ворчал насчёт цены.

definition: to pause before doing something because you are not sure
sentence: I {hesitated} for a second and then pressed 'buy'.
translation: Я секунду поколебался и нажал «купить».

definition: to make people notice the most important part of something
sentence: The report {highlights} three problems with the old system.
translation: В отчёте выделены три проблемы старой системы.

definition: to force a rule, tax or opinion on people
sentence: The city {imposed} a fee for driving in the centre.
translation: Город ввёл плату за въезд в центр.

definition: to include something as part of a bigger whole
sentence: We {incorporated} your ideas into the final design.
translation: Мы включили ваши идеи в итоговый дизайн.

definition: to show or point out that something is true or exists
sentence: Dark clouds usually {indicate} that rain is coming.
translation: Тёмные тучи обычно означают, что скоро дождь.

definition: to receive money or property from someone after their death
sentence: She {inherited} the house from her grandmother.
translation: Она унаследовала дом от бабушки.

definition: to make someone want to do something good or creative
sentence: Her story {inspired} me to start running again.
translation: Её история вдохновила меня снова начать бегать.

definition: to get involved in a situation that is not your business
sentence: Please don't {interfere} in my argument with my sister.
translation: Пожалуйста, не вмешивайся в мой спор с сестрой.

definition: to decide what the meaning of something is
sentence: How do you {interpret} his silence at dinner?
translation: Как ты понимаешь его молчание за ужином?

definition: to become involved in a situation to change what happens
sentence: The teacher {intervened} before the fight got serious.
translation: Учитель вмешался, пока драка не стала серьёзной.

definition: to give a good reason why something is right
sentence: How can you {justify} spending that much on shoes?
translation: Как ты можешь оправдать такие траты на обувь?

definition: to stay somewhere longer than needed because you do not want to leave
sentence: We {lingered} at the cafe until it closed.
translation: Мы засиделись в кафе до самого закрытия.

definition: to control or influence someone in a clever, unfair way
sentence: He {manipulated} his friends into paying for everything.
translation: Он так ловко всё устроил, что друзья за всё заплатили.

definition: to change something slightly to make it better or different
sentence: We {modified} the recipe to use less butter.
translation: Мы немного изменили рецепт, чтобы было меньше масла.

definition: to discuss something to reach an agreement
sentence: I {negotiated} a lower rent with the landlord.
translation: Я договорился с хозяином о более низкой аренде.

definition: to fail to take care of someone or something
sentence: I've {neglected} my friends since I started this job.
translation: С тех пор как я начал эту работу, я забросил друзей.

definition: to get something, often by effort or asking
sentence: Where can I {obtain} a copy of my birth certificate?
translation: Где можно получить копию свидетельства о рождении?

definition: to live in or use a place, room or seat
sentence: Someone's bag is {occupying} the only free seat.
translation: Чья-то сумка занимает единственное свободное место.

definition: to leave something out, on purpose or by mistake
sentence: You {omitted} the most important detail from the story.
translation: Ты пропустил самую важную деталь в истории.

definition: to disagree with a plan and try to stop it
sentence: Most of the neighbours {oppose} the new car park.
translation: Большинство соседей против новой парковки.

definition: to deal with and win against a problem or fear
sentence: She {overcame} her fear of flying last summer.
translation: Прошлым летом она преодолела страх полётов.

definition: to fail to notice something important
sentence: I {overlooked} one small mistake and lost the whole bonus.
translation: Я не заметил одну мелкую ошибку и лишился всей премии.

definition: to continue doing something even though it is difficult
sentence: If the pain {persists}, see a doctor.
translation: Если боль не проходит, сходи к врачу.

definition: to make someone agree to do something by giving reasons
sentence: My brother {persuaded} me to try the spicy soup.
translation: Брат уговорил меня попробовать острый суп.

definition: to make a serious public promise
sentence: The company {pledged} to plant a tree for every order.
translation: Компания пообещала сажать дерево за каждый заказ.

definition: to move an event to a later time
sentence: Let's {postpone} the picnic until the rain stops.
translation: Давай отложим пикник, пока не закончится дождь.

definition: to think that something is true although you are not sure
sentence: I {presume} you've already eaten, so I didn't cook.
translation: Я предположил, что ты уже поел, и ничего не готовил.

definition: to win or be the strongest in the end
sentence: Common sense {prevailed} and we went home before midnight.
translation: Здравый смысл победил, и мы ушли домой до полуночи.

definition: to officially say that something is not allowed
sentence: Smoking is {prohibited} anywhere near the playground.
translation: Курить рядом с детской площадкой запрещено.

definition: to try hard to achieve something over a long time
sentence: She decided to {pursue} a career in music after all.
translation: Она всё-таки решила строить карьеру в музыке.

definition: to say something that makes a worried person feel calm
sentence: The nurse {reassured} me that the test was routine.
translation: Медсестра успокоила меня, сказав, что анализ обычный.

definition: to think or believe something, often a guess
sentence: I {reckon} the train will be late again.
translation: Думаю, поезд снова опоздает.

definition: to control an activity with rules
sentence: This device {regulates} the temperature in the room.
translation: Этот прибор регулирует температуру в комнате.

definition: to make a feeling, idea or structure stronger
sentence: The trip only {reinforced} my wish to live by the sea.
translation: Поездка лишь укрепила моё желание жить у моря.

definition: to refuse to accept an offer, idea or person
sentence: They {rejected} my offer without even reading it.
translation: Они отклонили моё предложение, даже не прочитав.

definition: to look like or be similar to someone or something
sentence: You {resemble} your father when you laugh.
translation: Когда ты смеёшься, ты похож на отца.

definition: to officially leave your job
sentence: He {resigned} after a fight with his boss.
translation: Он уволился после ссоры с начальником.

definition: to stop yourself from doing something you want
sentence: I couldn't {resist} buying one more pair of boots.
translation: Я не удержалась и купила ещё одну пару сапог.

definition: to find a solution to a problem or argument
sentence: We {resolved} the issue with the bill in two minutes.
translation: Мы уладили вопрос со счётом за две минуты.

definition: to bring something back to its earlier good condition
sentence: They {restored} the old cinema and it looks amazing.
translation: Они отреставрировали старый кинотеатр, и он выглядит потрясающе.

definition: to limit how much someone can do, have or use
sentence: The doctor {restricted} my coffee to one cup a day.
translation: Врач ограничил меня одной чашкой кофе в день.

definition: to keep something instead of losing or giving it away
sentence: The hotel {retains} your card details for a week.
translation: Отель хранит данные вашей карты неделю.

definition: to get something back from the place where you left it
sentence: I went back to {retrieve} my umbrella from the bar.
translation: Я вернулся в бар, чтобы забрать свой зонт.

definition: to make something known that was secret or hidden
sentence: She finally {revealed} where she had hidden the gifts.
translation: Она наконец раскрыла, где спрятала подарки.

definition: to take hold of something quickly and with force
sentence: He {seized} my arm as I was about to fall.
translation: Он схватил меня за руку, когда я чуть не упал.

definition: to become smaller in size or amount
sentence: My favourite sweater {shrank} in the wash.
translation: Мой любимый свитер сел после стирки.

definition: to rise very quickly to a high level
sentence: Ticket prices {soared} the week before the concert.
translation: За неделю до концерта цены на билеты взлетели.

definition: to guess about something without knowing all the facts
sentence: Everyone is {speculating} about who will get the job.
translation: Все гадают, кто получит эту должность.

definition: to make something more active or make it grow
sentence: A short walk {stimulates} my brain better than coffee.
translation: Короткая прогулка бодрит мой мозг лучше кофе.

definition: to try very hard to achieve something
sentence: We {strive} to answer every message within a day.
translation: Мы стараемся отвечать на каждое сообщение в течение дня.

definition: to give a document or form to a person in authority
sentence: I {submitted} my application ten minutes before the deadline.
translation: Я подал заявку за десять минут до дедлайна.

definition: to officially stop something for a short time
sentence: The club {suspended} him for two games.
translation: Клуб отстранил его на две игры.

definition: to keep something going at the same level over time
sentence: I can't {sustain} this pace of work for much longer.
translation: Я не смогу долго держать такой темп работы.

definition: to begin dealing with a difficult problem
sentence: Let's {tackle} the kitchen first and then the bedroom.
translation: Давай сначала разберёмся с кухней, а потом со спальней.

definition: to accept something you do not like without complaining
sentence: I can {tolerate} noise, but not that smell.
translation: Шум я ещё могу терпеть, но не этот запах.

definition: to change something completely into something different
sentence: A coat of paint {transformed} the whole room.
translation: Один слой краски полностью преобразил комнату.

definition: to experience something difficult, such as a medical treatment
sentence: My dad will {undergo} knee surgery next week.
translation: На следующей неделе папе будут делать операцию на колене.

definition: to agree to do a big task and start doing it
sentence: We {undertook} the renovation without any help.
translation: Мы взялись за ремонт без чьей-либо помощи.

definition: to strongly advise someone to do something
sentence: I {urge} you to book the tickets today.
translation: Я настоятельно советую тебе купить билеты сегодня.

definition: to go away all at once so nobody can see it any more
sentence: My keys {vanished} somewhere between the car and the door.
translation: Мои ключи куда-то пропали между машиной и дверью.

definition: to break a rule, law or agreement
sentence: The driver {violated} three rules in one minute.
translation: Водитель нарушил три правила за одну минуту.

definition: to take money out of a bank account
sentence: I need to {withdraw} some cash before the trip.
translation: Мне нужно снять немного наличных перед поездкой.

definition: to stay strong and not be damaged by something
sentence: These boots can {withstand} rain, snow and mud.
translation: Эти ботинки выдерживают дождь, снег и грязь.

definition: to produce a result, crop or profit
sentence: The small garden {yields} enough tomatoes for the whole summer.
translation: Маленький огород даёт достаточно помидоров на всё лето.

definition: a strong wish to be successful or achieve something big
sentence: My {ambition} is to open my own bakery one day.
translation: Моя мечта — однажды открыть собственную пекарню.

definition: a feeling of worry or fear about what might happen
sentence: I get a lot of {anxiety} before job interviews.
translation: Перед собеседованиями я сильно нервничаю.

definition: something useful or valuable that a person or company owns
sentence: Her calm voice is a real {asset} in this job.
translation: Её спокойный голос — настоящее преимущество в этой работе.

definition: something you believe is true without any proof
sentence: You made the {assumption} that I would pay for dinner.
translation: Ты просто решил, что за ужин заплачу я.

definition: something that stops people from doing or getting something
sentence: Language was the biggest {barrier} when we moved here.
translation: Язык был главным препятствием, когда мы сюда переехали.

definition: an unfair opinion that makes you treat someone or something differently
sentence: He has a clear {bias} against anyone younger than him.
translation: У него явное предубеждение против всех, кто моложе его.

definition: a line or limit that shows where something ends
sentence: I need to set a {boundary} about work calls after eight.
translation: Мне нужно провести границу: никаких рабочих звонков после восьми.

definition: an important discovery or success after a long effort
sentence: Switching to mornings was a {breakthrough} for my running.
translation: Переход на утренние пробежки стал для меня прорывом.

definition: a heavy duty or worry that is difficult to carry
sentence: I don't want to be a {burden} on my parents.
translation: Я не хочу быть обузой для родителей.

definition: the largest amount or number that something can hold
sentence: The hall has a {capacity} of two hundred people.
translation: Зал вмещает двести человек.

definition: a state of complete confusion with no order
sentence: The kitchen was total {chaos} after the kids' party.
translation: После детского праздника на кухне был полный хаос.

definition: a piece of information that helps you find the answer
sentence: I have no {clue} where I left my phone.
translation: Понятия не имею, где я оставил телефон.

definition: a promise to do something or to stay with someone
sentence: A puppy is a big {commitment} for ten years or more.
translation: Щенок — это серьёзное обязательство на десять лет и больше.

definition: an agreement where each side gives up part of what it wants
sentence: We reached a {compromise}: pizza tonight, salad tomorrow.
translation: Мы пришли к компромиссу: сегодня пицца, завтра салат.

definition: a result of an action, often a bad one
sentence: Missing the bus had one {consequence}: I missed the interview.
translation: У опоздания на автобус было одно последствие: я пропустил собеседование.

definition: something that limits what you can do
sentence: Time is the main {constraint} on this project.
translation: Главное ограничение в этом проекте — время.

definition: a lot of public disagreement and argument about something
sentence: The new parking fee caused a lot of {controversy} in town.
translation: Новая плата за парковку вызвала в городе много споров.

definition: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people
sentence: He didn't even have the {courtesy} to call and cancel.
translation: Он даже не удосужился позвонить и отменить встречу.

definition: a time when things are very bad or dangerous
sentence: We had a small {crisis} when the oven stopped working.
translation: У нас случился небольшой кризис, когда сломалась духовка.

definition: the day or time by which something must be finished
sentence: The {deadline} for the report is Monday morning.
translation: Срок сдачи отчёта — утро понедельника.

definition: a situation where you must choose between two difficult options
sentence: I'm in a {dilemma}: a better salary or a shorter commute.
translation: Я перед дилеммой: зарплата выше или дорога короче.

definition: the ability to make yourself do what you should
sentence: It takes {discipline} to study every evening after work.
translation: Нужна дисциплина, чтобы заниматься каждый вечер после работы.

definition: a clear difference between two similar things
sentence: There's a big {distinction} between being tired and being lazy.
translation: Есть большая разница между усталостью и ленью.

definition: a disadvantage or problem that makes something less good
sentence: The only {drawback} of the flat is the noisy street.
translation: Единственный минус квартиры — шумная улица.

definition: special importance given to one thing
sentence: The coach puts a lot of {emphasis} on sleep.
translation: Тренер придаёт большое значение сну.

definition: a strong feeling of interest and excitement about something
sentence: I lost my {enthusiasm} for the gym after two weeks.
translation: Через две недели мой запал к спортзалу пропал.

definition: a long period of history with its own character
sentence: Smartphones changed the way we live in one short {era}.
translation: Смартфоны изменили нашу жизнь за один короткий период.

definition: a guess about the size, cost or amount of something
sentence: The builder gave us an {estimate} of ten thousand.
translation: Строитель оценил работу примерно в десять тысяч.

definition: special skill or knowledge in a particular area
sentence: We need someone with {expertise} in tax law.
translation: Нам нужен кто-то с опытом в налоговом праве.

definition: a feeling of being extremely tired
sentence: By Friday the {fatigue} was so bad I slept twelve hours.
translation: К пятнице усталость была такой, что я проспал двенадцать часов.

definition: a small mistake or weakness that makes something not perfect
sentence: The plan has one {flaw}: nobody has a car.
translation: В плане один изъян: ни у кого нет машины.

definition: a very large amount of money
sentence: That jacket must have cost a {fortune}.
translation: Эта куртка, наверное, стоила целое состояние.

definition: too much worry or noise about something small
sentence: Don't make a {fuss}, it's just a small scratch.
translation: Не поднимай шум, это всего лишь царапина.

definition: a movement of your hand or head that shows what you mean
sentence: She made a {gesture} for me to sit down.
translation: Она жестом показала, чтобы я сел.

definition: a very quick and not complete look at something
sentence: I caught a {glimpse} of her in the crowd and lost her.
translation: Я мельком увидел её в толпе и потерял из виду.

definition: deep sadness, especially after someone has died
sentence: It took him years to get over the {grief} of losing his wife.
translation: Ему понадобились годы, чтобы пережить горе после потери жены.

definition: the bad feeling you have when you know you did something wrong
sentence: I felt a wave of {guilt} for forgetting her birthday.
translation: Я почувствовал укол вины за то, что забыл её день рождения.

definition: something that could be dangerous or cause harm
sentence: Those loose cables are a real {hazard} in a kitchen.
translation: Эти болтающиеся провода на кухне — настоящая опасность.

definition: the buildings, traditions and culture passed down from the past
sentence: The old town is part of the city's {heritage}.
translation: Старый город — часть наследия этого города.

definition: a small piece of advice or information given in an indirect way
sentence: Give me a {hint}: is the present bigger than a book?
translation: Подскажи немного: подарок больше книги?

definition: strong bad feelings towards someone, shown in words or actions
sentence: I don't understand the {hostility} between the two neighbours.
translation: Не понимаю, откуда такая вражда между этими соседями.

definition: a strong effect that something has on a situation or person
sentence: Moving abroad had a huge {impact} on my career.
translation: Переезд за границу сильно повлиял на мою карьеру.

definition: something that makes you want to work harder or do something
sentence: A free lunch is a good {incentive} to come to the office.
translation: Бесплатный обед — хороший стимул приходить в офис.

definition: a clear and deep understanding of a complicated thing
sentence: Her book gave me a real {insight} into how banks work.
translation: Её книга дала мне настоящее понимание того, как работают банки.

definition: a natural feeling that makes you act without thinking
sentence: My first {instinct} was to run, but I stayed.
translation: Первым порывом было убежать, но я остался.

definition: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles
sentence: I trust him because he has real {integrity}.
translation: Я ему доверяю, потому что он по-настоящему порядочный человек.

definition: something you plan or mean to do
sentence: I have no {intention} of working this weekend.
translation: Я не собираюсь работать в эти выходные.

definition: a situation that is funny because it is the opposite of what you expected
sentence: The {irony} is that the doctor was the one who got sick.
translation: Ирония в том, что заболел как раз врач.

definition: something that a person leaves behind after they die or leave
sentence: Her {legacy} at the school is the big library.
translation: Её наследие в школе — большая библиотека.

definition: free time when you are not working
sentence: I spend most of my {leisure} time on my bike.
translation: Большую часть свободного времени я провожу на велосипеде.

definition: how probable it is that something will happen
sentence: In all {likelihood} the meeting will be moved again.
translation: Скорее всего, встречу снова перенесут.

definition: the amount by which one thing is bigger or better than another
sentence: We won by a {margin} of two points.
translation: Мы выиграли с разницей в два очка.

definition: the reason why a person does something
sentence: I don't understand his {motive} for lying about it.
translation: Я не понимаю, зачем ему было об этом врать.

definition: a story or idea that many people believe but that is not true
sentence: It's a {myth} that cold weather gives you a cold.
translation: Это миф, что от холодной погоды можно простудиться.

definition: a person or thing that annoys you or causes small problems
sentence: The mosquitoes were a real {nuisance} on the terrace.
translation: Комары на террасе были настоящей напастью.

definition: something that stops you from going forward or succeeding
sentence: The biggest {obstacle} to buying a flat is the deposit.
translation: Главное препятствие при покупке квартиры — первый взнос.

definition: the final result of a process or event
sentence: Whatever the {outcome}, I'm glad we tried.
translation: Каким бы ни был результат, я рад, что мы попытались.

definition: the speed at which something happens or someone moves
sentence: Slow down, I can't keep up with your {pace}.
translation: Помедленнее, я не поспеваю за твоим темпом.

definition: the way you see or understand something
sentence: My {perception} of the city changed after a week there.
translation: Моё восприятие города изменилось после недели там.

definition: a way of thinking about something from a particular position
sentence: Travelling gave me a new {perspective} on my own country.
translation: Путешествия дали мне новый взгляд на собственную страну.

definition: an unfair dislike of a group of people formed without good reason
sentence: There's still a lot of {prejudice} against people with accents.
translation: Предвзятости к людям с акцентом по-прежнему много.

definition: the thing that is more important than anything else
sentence: Sleep is my top {priority} this week.
translation: На этой неделе мой главный приоритет — сон.

definition: a special right or advantage that only some people have
sentence: It's a {privilege} to work with people I actually like.
translation: Это привилегия — работать с людьми, которые мне по-настоящему нравятся.

definition: the size of one part compared with the whole
sentence: A large {proportion} of my salary goes on rent.
translation: Большая часть моей зарплаты уходит на аренду.

definition: the possibility that something will happen in the future
sentence: The {prospect} of another winter here scares me.
translation: Перспектива ещё одной зимы здесь меня пугает.

definition: the act of trying to get or achieve something
sentence: He moved to Berlin in {pursuit} of a music career.
translation: Он переехал в Берлин в погоне за музыкальной карьерой.

definition: a cure or a way to solve a problem
sentence: Hot tea with honey is my {remedy} for a sore throat.
translation: Горячий чай с мёдом — моё средство от больного горла.

definition: a feeling of anger because you were treated unfairly
sentence: I still feel some {resentment} about how they fired me.
translation: Я до сих пор немного обижен на то, как меня уволили.

definition: a meeting of people who have not seen each other for a long time
sentence: Our school {reunion} is in May, are you going?
translation: Встреча выпускников в мае, ты идёшь?

definition: a story that people repeat but that may not be true
sentence: There's a {rumour} that the cafe is closing down.
translation: Ходит слух, что кафе закрывается.

definition: something valuable you give up to get something more important
sentence: Moving away from my family was a big {sacrifice}.
translation: Переезд далеко от семьи стал большой жертвой.

definition: a plan for doing or organising something
sentence: The city started a {scheme} for cheap bike rentals.
translation: Город запустил программу дешёвой аренды велосипедов.

definition: a situation where there is not enough of something
sentence: There's a {shortage} of nurses in every hospital here.
translation: Здесь в каждой больнице не хватает медсестёр.

definition: a public opinion or position on a particular question
sentence: What's your {stance} on working from home?
translation: Как ты относишься к работе из дома?

definition: a fixed idea about what a type of person is like
sentence: Not every programmer fits the {stereotype} of a quiet guy.
translation: Не каждый программист соответствует стереотипу тихони.

definition: pressure caused by too much work, worry or weight
sentence: The long hours put a lot of {strain} on our marriage.
translation: Долгие рабочие часы сильно давили на наш брак.

definition: a hard fight or effort to do or get something
sentence: Getting up at five is a daily {struggle} for me.
translation: Вставать в пять — для меня ежедневная борьба.

definition: an amount that is more than what is needed
sentence: We have a {surplus} of apples, take some home.
translation: У нас избыток яблок, забери немного домой.

definition: a feeling that someone has done something wrong
sentence: I have a {suspicion} that he read my messages.
translation: Подозреваю, что он читал мои сообщения.

definition: the feeling of being sorry for someone who has problems
sentence: I have a lot of {sympathy} for people working night shifts.
translation: Мне очень жаль людей, которые работают в ночную смену.

definition: a strong wish to do something you know you should not do
sentence: The {temptation} to check my phone in bed is huge.
translation: Соблазн проверить телефон в кровати огромен.

definition: a way that someone usually behaves or something usually happens
sentence: He has a {tendency} to talk over people.
translation: У него есть привычка перебивать людей.

definition: a warning or a danger that something bad will happen
sentence: Rain is the main {threat} to our picnic plans.
translation: Дождь — главная угроза нашим планам на пикник.

definition: a particular quality in a person's character
sentence: Patience is not one of my strong {traits}.
translation: Терпение — не самая сильная моя черта.

definition: a general direction in which something is changing or developing
sentence: Working from cafes is a big {trend} in our city.
translation: Работать из кафе — большой тренд в нашем городе.

definition: a great success or victory
sentence: Finishing the marathon was a personal {triumph} for me.
translation: Финиш марафона стал для меня личным триумфом.

definition: a state of great confusion, worry or disorder
sentence: My life was in {turmoil} after the move.
translation: После переезда моя жизнь была в полном раздрае.

definition: a new business or activity that involves risk
sentence: Their coffee {venture} failed after six months.
translation: Их кофейный бизнес прогорел через полгода.

definition: the decision of a court about whether someone is guilty
sentence: The jury took two days to reach a {verdict}.
translation: Присяжным понадобилось два дня, чтобы вынести вердикт.

definition: a good quality in a person's character
sentence: Her greatest {virtue} is that she never lies.
translation: Её главное достоинство в том, что она никогда не врёт.

definition: the health, comfort and happiness of a person or group
sentence: The school really cares about the {welfare} of its students.
translation: Школа действительно заботится о благополучии учеников.

definition: existing in large amounts, more than enough
sentence: Fresh fish is {abundant} and cheap in this town.
translation: Свежей рыбы в этом городе полно, и она дешёвая.

definition: correct in every small part, with nothing wrong
sentence: Is the clock in the kitchen {accurate}? Mine says ten.
translation: Часы на кухне точные? На моих десять.

definition: enough in amount or good enough for a purpose
sentence: The flat is small but {adequate} for one person.
translation: Квартира маленькая, но для одного человека вполне подходит.

definition: having more than one possible meaning, not clear
sentence: His message was so {ambiguous} that I didn't know if he was coming.
translation: Его сообщение было таким двусмысленным, что я не понял, придёт ли он.

definition: worried and nervous about something that might happen
sentence: I'm {anxious} about the test results tomorrow.
translation: Я тревожусь из-за завтрашних результатов анализов.

definition: easy to see or understand, obvious
sentence: It was {apparent} from her face that she hadn't slept.
translation: По её лицу было видно, что она не спала.

definition: decided by chance or personal choice, not for a good reason
sentence: The limit of three bags seems completely {arbitrary} to me.
translation: Лимит в три сумки кажется мне совершенно произвольным.

definition: making you feel shy and not comfortable
sentence: There was an {awkward} silence after his joke.
translation: После его шутки повисло неловкое молчание.

definition: full of bad feeling for a long time because of something that was not fair
sentence: He's still {bitter} about losing that job.
translation: Он до сих пор зол из-за потери той работы.

definition: saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite
sentence: To be {blunt}, your plan is not going to work.
translation: Скажу прямо: твой план не сработает.

definition: very careful, so that nothing bad happens
sentence: Be {cautious} on the stairs, they are wet.
translation: Осторожнее на лестнице, она мокрая.

definition: clear and logical, with all the parts connected well
sentence: After three coffees I could finally give a {coherent} answer.
translation: После трёх чашек кофе я наконец смог ответить связно.

definition: something you must do because of a rule or law
sentence: Helmets are {compulsory} on this bike trail.
translation: На этой велотрассе шлем обязателен.

definition: aware of something, noticing that it exists
sentence: I'm very {conscious} of how much I spend on coffee.
translation: Я прекрасно осознаю, сколько трачу на кофе.

definition: large in amount, size or importance
sentence: We spent a {considerable} amount on the wedding.
translation: Мы потратили на свадьбу немалую сумму.

definition: always behaving or happening in the same way
sentence: Her results have been {consistent} all season.
translation: Её результаты были стабильными весь сезон.

definition: extremely important for the result of something
sentence: The next two weeks are {crucial} for the project.
translation: Следующие две недели решают судьбу проекта.

definition: clever at getting what you want, often by tricking people
sentence: The cat is {cunning} enough to open the fridge.
translation: Кот достаточно хитёр, чтобы открыть холодильник.

definition: done on purpose, not by accident
sentence: That was a {deliberate} foul, not an accident.
translation: Это был умышленный фол, а не случайность.

definition: easy to break or damage, needing careful handling
sentence: Those glasses are {delicate}, so wash them by hand.
translation: Эти бокалы хрупкие, так что мой их вручную.

definition: needing or wanting something so much that you will do anything
sentence: I'm {desperate} for a holiday after this month.
translation: После этого месяца мне отчаянно нужен отпуск.

definition: clearly different or separate from other things
sentence: The two cheeses have very {distinct} tastes.
translation: У этих двух сыров совершенно разный вкус.

definition: not interesting at all, so you want to stop watching or listening
sentence: The film was so {dull} that I fell asleep.
translation: Фильм был такой скучный, что я уснул.

definition: wanting very much to do or have something
sentence: The kids are {eager} to see the snow.
translation: Дети очень хотят увидеть снег.

definition: allowed to do or have something because you meet the rules
sentence: You're {eligible} for a discount if you're under 26.
translation: Если тебе меньше 26, тебе положена скидка.

definition: completely necessary, so important you cannot do without it
sentence: Good shoes are {essential} for a long walk.
translation: Хорошая обувь необходима для долгой прогулки.

definition: easy to see or understand, obvious
sentence: It's {evident} that he hasn't read the contract.
translation: Очевидно, что он не читал договор.

definition: more than is reasonable or needed
sentence: Twenty euros for a sandwich is {excessive}.
translation: Двадцать евро за сэндвич — это перебор.

definition: very weak and hard to see, hear or smell
sentence: I heard a {faint} noise from the basement.
translation: Я услышал слабый шум из подвала.

definition: very strong, with a lot of force or bad feeling
sentence: There was a {fierce} argument about who should pay.
translation: Разгорелся яростный спор о том, кто должен платить.

definition: easily broken or damaged
sentence: Pack the vase carefully, it's very {fragile}.
translation: Упакуй вазу аккуратно, она очень хрупкая.

definition: honest and direct, even when it is not pleasant
sentence: I'll be {frank}: I didn't like the food.
translation: Буду честен: еда мне не понравилась.

definition: real and exactly what it seems to be, not fake
sentence: Is this bag {genuine} leather or plastic?
translation: Эта сумка из настоящей кожи или из пластика?

definition: dark and sad, without hope
sentence: The flat looks {gloomy} on rainy days.
translation: В дождливые дни квартира выглядит мрачно.

definition: feeling thankful for something someone did for you
sentence: I'm so {grateful} you drove me to the airport.
translation: Я так благодарна, что ты отвёз меня в аэропорт.

definition: too hard, strong or cold, and not kind
sentence: The winters here are {harsh}, with wind and ice.
translation: Зимы здесь суровые, с ветром и льдом.

definition: not friendly, ready to fight
sentence: The waiter was {hostile} from the moment we sat down.
translation: Официант был враждебно настроен с той минуты, как мы сели.

definition: not thinking you are better or more important than others
sentence: He's very {humble} for someone that famous.
translation: Он очень скромный для такого известного человека.

definition: not working or being used, doing nothing
sentence: The machine has been {idle} since the factory closed.
translation: Станок простаивает с тех пор, как закрыли завод.

definition: extremely large in size or amount
sentence: The park is {immense}, you can walk for hours.
translation: Парк огромный, можно гулять часами.

definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
sentence: After that goal, defeat was {inevitable}.
translation: После того гола поражение было неизбежно.

definition: very interested in something and wanting to do it
sentence: She's {keen} to start the course as soon as possible.
translation: Ей не терпится начать курс как можно скорее.

definition: always supporting a person or group, even in bad times
sentence: He stayed {loyal} to the club through every bad season.
translation: Он оставался верен клубу в каждый неудачный сезон.

definition: acting like a wise adult, not like a child
sentence: She's very {mature} for a fifteen-year-old.
translation: Она очень взрослая для своих пятнадцати лет.

definition: not talking much about your own abilities or success
sentence: He's too {modest} to tell you he won the prize.
translation: Он слишком скромен, чтобы сказать, что выиграл приз.

definition: believing people too easily because you have little experience
sentence: I was {naive} to think the landlord would fix it quickly.
translation: Наивно было думать, что хозяин быстро всё починит.

definition: famous for something bad
sentence: This junction is {notorious} for accidents.
translation: Этот перекрёсток печально известен авариями.

definition: easy to see or understand, clear to anyone
sentence: It's {obvious} that she likes you.
translation: Очевидно же, что ты ей нравишься.

definition: extremely good, much better than usual
sentence: The service at that hotel was {outstanding}.
translation: Сервис в том отеле был выдающимся.

definition: not normal, different from others, sometimes in an interesting way
sentence: There's a {peculiar} smell coming from the fridge.
translation: Из холодильника идёт какой-то странный запах.

definition: not normal, not what you expect
sentence: It's {odd} that he hasn't called all week.
translation: Странно, что он не звонил всю неделю.

definition: exact and correct in every small part
sentence: Can you give me the {precise} time of the train?
translation: Можешь сказать точное время поезда?

definition: very great, deep or strong in its effect
sentence: Her advice had a {profound} effect on my life.
translation: Её совет оказал глубокое влияние на мою жизнь.

definition: not wanting to do something and slow to agree
sentence: I was {reluctant} to lend him money again.
translation: Мне не хотелось снова одалживать ему деньги.

definition: so stupid that people can only laugh at it
sentence: The rent they ask for that tiny room is {ridiculous}.
translation: Аренда, которую они просят за эту каморку, просто смешная.

definition: not able to change or bend, very strict
sentence: Her diet is so {rigid} that she can't eat out.
translation: Её диета такая строгая, что она не может есть в кафе.

definition: having no pity, doing anything to get what you want
sentence: Their boss is {ruthless} about deadlines.
translation: Их начальник беспощаден, когда дело касается сроков.

definition: not easy to find, existing in small amounts
sentence: Parking is {scarce} around the stadium on match days.
translation: В дни матчей возле стадиона почти негде припарковаться.

definition: showing good judgement, practical and reasonable
sentence: Taking a taxi at night was the {sensible} choice.
translation: Взять такси ночью было разумным решением.

definition: very bad, serious or extreme
sentence: He has a {severe} allergy to nuts.
translation: У него тяжёлая аллергия на орехи.

definition: honest and really meaning what you say
sentence: Please accept my {sincere} apologies for the delay.
translation: Пожалуйста, примите мои искренние извинения за задержку.

definition: not changing, continuing at the same level
sentence: Keep a {steady} pace and you'll finish the run.
translation: Держи ровный темп, и ты добежишь.

definition: refusing to change your mind even when you should
sentence: He's too {stubborn} to ask for directions.
translation: Он слишком упрямый, чтобы спросить дорогу.

definition: not obvious, small and hard to notice
sentence: There's a {subtle} difference between the two colours.
translation: Между этими двумя цветами едва заметная разница.

definition: boring and lasting too long
sentence: Filling in those forms is a {tedious} job.
translation: Заполнять эти формы — нудное занятие.

definition: done with great care, looking at every small part
sentence: The mechanic did a {thorough} check of the brakes.
translation: Механик тщательно проверил тормоза.

definition: small and not important
sentence: We argued about something {trivial}, like whose turn to cook.
translation: Мы поспорили из-за какой-то мелочи вроде того, чья очередь готовить.

definition: not clear or exact, hard to understand
sentence: He gave a {vague} answer about when he'd be back.
translation: Он уклончиво ответил, когда вернётся.

definition: extremely large in size or amount
sentence: A {vast} field of sunflowers stretched behind the house.
translation: За домом раскинулось огромное поле подсолнухов.

definition: very bright, clear and strong, easy to imagine
sentence: I still have a {vivid} memory of my first day at school.
translation: Я до сих пор ярко помню свой первый день в школе.

definition: weak and easy to hurt or attack
sentence: Old people are the most {vulnerable} in this heat.
translation: Пожилые люди больше всех уязвимы в такую жару.

definition: very strange and hard to explain
sentence: It's {weird} that the lights turn on by themselves.
translation: Странно, что свет включается сам по себе.

definition: very quickly and without any sign that it was coming
sentence: The bus stopped so {abruptly} that I dropped my coffee.
translation: Автобус затормозил так резко, что я уронил кофе.

definition: according to what you have heard, though you are not sure
sentence: {Apparently} the shop opens at nine, not eight.
translation: Судя по всему, магазин открывается в девять, а не в восемь.

definition: only just, almost not at all
sentence: I {barely} made it to the train on time.
translation: Я едва успел на поезд.

definition: on purpose, not by accident
sentence: She {deliberately} left her phone at home for the weekend.
translation: Она нарочно оставила телефон дома на выходные.

definition: in the end, after a long time or many problems
sentence: We {eventually} found a parking spot three streets away.
translation: В конце концов мы нашли место для парковки через три улицы.

definition: speaking honestly, even if it is not pleasant
sentence: {Frankly}, I don't think the dress suits you.
translation: Честно говоря, не думаю, что это платье тебе идёт.

definition: slowly, by small steps over a period of time
sentence: The days are {gradually} getting longer.
translation: Дни постепенно становятся длиннее.

definition: almost not at all
sentence: I could {hardly} hear her over the music.
translation: Я почти не слышал её из-за музыки.

definition: more and more over time
sentence: It's {increasingly} difficult to find a flat here.
translation: Найти квартиру здесь становится всё труднее.

definition: in the exact meaning of the words, not as a figure of speech
sentence: I {literally} ran into my boss at the supermarket.
translation: Я в буквальном смысле столкнулся с начальником в супермаркете.

definition: only, nothing more than
sentence: I was {merely} asking, you don't have to shout.
translation: Я просто спросил, не надо кричать.

definition: sometimes, but not often
sentence: We {occasionally} go to the cinema on Sundays.
translation: Иногда по воскресеньям мы ходим в кино.

definition: probably, judging by what you know
sentence: {Presumably} he's stuck in traffic again.
translation: Наверное, он опять застрял в пробке.

definition: not often, almost never
sentence: I {rarely} eat meat these days.
translation: В последнее время я редко ем мясо.

definition: quickly and willingly, without any problem
sentence: She {readily} agreed to swap shifts with me.
translation: Она с готовностью согласилась поменяться со мной сменами.

definition: about, more or less, not exactly
sentence: The trip takes {roughly} two hours by car.
translation: Поездка занимает примерно два часа на машине.

definition: only just, almost not
sentence: I had {scarcely} sat down when the phone rang.
translation: Едва я сел, как зазвонил телефон.

definition: appearing to be true, although it may not be
sentence: He was {seemingly} calm, but his hands were shaking.
translation: Он казался спокойным, но руки у него дрожали.

definition: a little, by a small amount
sentence: The soup is {slightly} too salty for me.
translation: Суп для меня немного пересолен.

definition: to some degree, a little
sentence: The hotel was {somewhat} smaller than in the photos.
translation: Отель оказался несколько меньше, чем на фотографиях.

definition: at a regular speed, without stopping or changing
sentence: Prices have been rising {steadily} all year.
translation: Цены весь год неуклонно растут.

definition: completely and with great care
sentence: Wash the mushrooms {thoroughly} before cooking.
translation: Тщательно вымой грибы перед готовкой.

definition: finally, after everything else has been considered
sentence: {Ultimately}, it's your decision, not mine.
translation: В конечном счёте решать тебе, а не мне.

definition: completely, totally
sentence: I was {utterly} exhausted after the move.
translation: После переезда я был совершенно вымотан.

definition: almost completely
sentence: The shop was {virtually} empty at that hour.
translation: В тот час магазин был практически пуст.
